Commentary: Salman Mirza to Wickramasinghe, 2 runs, very full ball on off, Wickramasinghe jams the drive to the right of long-on and comes rushing back to complete the second
Salman Mirza to Wickramasinghe, SIX, short and Wickramasinghe had all the time in the world to rock and maul it with a horizontal bat back over the sight screen for a mighty maximum

Salman Mirza to Wickramasinghe, out Caught by Fakhar Zaman!! Catching practice for extra cover. Pitched up wide of off stump, Chamindu Wickramasinghe goes hard on the drive and ends up slicing it straight to Fakhar inside the ring. Wickramasinghe c Fakhar Zaman b Salman Mirza 29(24) [4s-1 6s-1]
Salman Mirza to Binura Fernando, no run, juicy full toss outside off, Fernando thumps it straight to the fielder at extra cover

Naseem Shah to Maheesh Theekshana, 1 run, backs away and drives the full delivery to the left of long-off
Naseem Shah to Binura Fernando, byes, 1 run, looks to slog and misses, the keeper fumbles on the dive and enables a single
Naseem Shah to Maheesh Theekshana, no run, banged in short on the stumps, Theekshana seeks to pull and gets beaten on the top-edge
Naseem Shah to Maheesh Theekshana, FOUR, slower length ball wide of off, Theekshana clears his front leg and slogs it back past the bowler with plenty of bottom hand power
Naseem Shah to Maheesh Theekshana, 1 run, drives the full ball to deep cover and a single is all they will get. Pakistan with a massive 82-run win to seal the series.
